svg.title: Power profiling of marked code with a PPK2, run by a developer, a CI job or an AI coding assistant
svg.desc: From top to bottom: a developer, a CI job and an AI coding assistant; a host with the west ppk2 commands of zephyr-ppk2 on top of ppk2-lib; a PPK2 on USB; a DUT running a Zephyr application with zephyr-ppk2 markers. The PPK2 supplies the DUT and takes the markers on its digital inputs. Beside the stack, the host builds zephyr.elf with the markers and the names of the regions linked in, flashes it to the DUT and reads the names back. At the right, the current of one cycle with its named regions, the charge of each, and a budget check that passes at 28 µC and fails at 42 µC.
